section_title: Money Laundering Risks in Financial Services > Control and ownership for AML compliance

propositions.proposition: 当审查所有权结构时，监管义务要求识别客户的最终受益所有人（UBO）
source_quotes: When reviewing ownership structures, there is a regulatory obligation to identify the UBO of a customer.

propositions.proposition: 为反洗钱目的，多数司法管辖区要求以25%或以上的门槛识别受益所有人
source_quotes: For AML purposes, most jurisdictions require beneficial ownership to be identified at a threshold of 25% or more.

propositions.proposition: 机构应采用风险为本的方法设定适当的受益所有权阈值
source_quotes: Your organization will set the appropriate threshold using a riskbased approach.

propositions.proposition: 对于某些高风险客户，受益所有权阈值可低至10%；对于风险显著更高的客户，阈值可低至5%
source_quotes: For certain high-risk customers, the beneficial ownership threshold might be as low as 10% and could go as low as 5% for customers who pose a significantly higher risk.

propositions.proposition: 在高风险司法管辖区有代理行关系的高风险金融机构可能将受益所有权阈值设定为5%
source_quotes: high-risk financial institutions with correspondent banking relationships in a high-risk jurisdiction might set their threshold at 5%.

propositions.proposition: 为了识别UBO，除了直接持股外，还需识别间接持股
source_quotes: In order to identify the UBOs of Company A, you need to identify indirect ownership stakes in addition to direct ownership.

propositions.proposition: 在没有自然人受益所有人的公司中，应识别并核实控制人或名义受益所有人，以便了解谁控制公司的决策
source_quotes: In companies where there is no natural beneficial owner, a controller or a notional beneficial owner should be identified and verified. This allows you to understand who is in control of the decision-making in the company when natural individual UBOs are not present.

propositions.proposition: 对于上市公司，名义受益所有人可以是总裁、首席执行官或同等职位
source_quotes: for a company that is publicly listed on the stock exchange and has thousands of shareholders, a notional beneficial owner could be the president or chief executive officer, or equivalent.
